chapter_seo_title: Chapter 318: The Gathering Storm — Alliance Forms Against Black Fiend Sect
chapter_meta_description: Allies assemble, plans are laid, but Han Li’s private calculation reveals a deeper motive. The night raid on the Imperial Palace draws closer.
og_title: The Gathering Storm — A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality
og_description: Chen Qiaoqian arrives with reinforcements. As the alliance takes shape, Han Li’s internal calculation reveals the secret that makes this risk worth taking.
twitter_description: The alliance against the Black Fiend Sect is sealed—but Han Li is only in it for a sliver of Core Formation odds.

lore_anchors.definition: A mysterious cultivation technique found in the underground chambers, mentioned in passing. Its properties are not elaborated in this chapter.
A ritual restriction placed on a subordinate’s body that allows a master to inflict lethal punishment remotely; an institutional leash in the cultivation world.
